manifest.name: dsh-expert-council
manifest.description: User-gated expert panels for DSH: describe adjustments in plain language, editable experts and team composition, explicit-use consent, isolation from built-in Agent Teams, evidence-first protocol, token budgets and a queryable decision ledger.
manifest.author: YansongG-HKU

bundle.text:
# dsh-expert-council bundle layer.
#
# One Host plugin row. The Host half owns the expert roster, the team presets,
# the collaboration protocol, the consult ledger, the `expert_council` tool,
# the `/experts` command, and the loopback panel route. The Client half
# (declared through `dsh.client`) renders the convening panel and calls the
# same Host service through that route.
- insert:
    - id: dsh-expert-council
      name: dsh-expert-council

> 一句话，召集一群专家给你做一次**有纪律**的评审。不是多开几个聊天，而是一套协议：独立成稿、证据门槛、只谈分歧、异议留档、裁决可复查。

[English](README.en.md) · [规格](docs/SPEC.md) · [更新日志](CHANGELOG.md) · [贡献指南](CONTRIBUTING.md)

DeepSeek Harness 插件（MIT 开源）：https://github.com/YansongG-HKU/dsh-expert-council

> **兼容性（DSH 0.2.2-rc.1）**：只读了 0.2.2 的公开接口变更（tools / systemPrompt / commands / webServer / slots / locale）并逐条核对，无破坏性变化；37/37 测试通过，真实桌面运行时正常注册 `expert_council` 工具、`/experts` 命令与面板。

Host 拥有专家镜头名册、用户自定义层、合作规范、token 预算与决策台账；Client 提供侧边栏面板与详情页；模型侧有一个工具 `expert_council`，人类侧有一条命令 `/experts`。三者写同一份台账。

**三条硬规则：** ① 只在你明确呼叫时使用（模型不得主动召开，工具层会拒绝）；② 专家角色与团队构成可以随时改、改完即时生效、可重置；③ 与 DSH 自带的智能体团队（Agent Teams）完全隔离，不共用名字、不创建子代理。

readme.section: 为什么它不是「表面好看」
readme.text:
| 机制 | 落地方式（不是提示词口号） |
| --- | --- |
| 专家定义 | 14 个镜头，每个都有 `mandate / lens / asks / redLines / misses / budget`；`misses` 明确写出每个镜头的盲区，面板把盲区作为「其他镜头会补」展示 |
| 独立先行 | 标准/深会诊先逐位成稿，深会诊用匿名编号互评；意见落库时记录 stance/confidence/claims |
| 证据门槛 | 每条 claim 必须带 `evidence`；无证据的意见被降级为「假设」，工具返回 `evidenceWarnings` 并在裁决时计入覆盖率 |
| 只谈分歧 | `record` 自动检测立场冲突与置信度差距（≥0.45），产出 `disagreements`；裁决时存在分歧却无 `dissent` 会被**拒绝**（带 force 也要写明理由） |
| 异议留档 | 裁决 JSON 必含 `dissent / unresolved / reversalTriggers / actions`；存在分歧时 dissent 不可为空 |
| 越权降权 | 专家只能在自己的镜头内计票；越界意见标 out-of-scope（协议第 5 条） |
| 预算硬顶 | 三档预算（lean/standard/deep），按团队与人数计算每人额度；`record` 统计实际 token，超支 20% 返回 `overBudget`；brief 里写明到顶即停 |
| 决策台账 | 会诊持久化到 `consults.json`：轮次、意见、分歧、裁决、token；`get/list/archive` 可复查；禁止覆盖已裁决的会诊 |
| 三入口一致 | `/experts`、面板、`expert_council` 工具全部调用同一个 `service`，门禁只有一份实现 |
| 显式调用门禁 | 模型主动 `convene` 会被拒绝；必须带 `explicit_request:true` + `request_quote`（用户原话），或由 `/experts` / 面板发起；同意记录写入 consult 台账 |
| 可自定义 | 专家与团队是「预置代码 + 用户数据」两层：可新增、可覆盖内置、可隐藏、可重置；面板编辑或 `save_expert` / `save_team` 写入 `customization.json`，立即生效 |
| 与内置团队隔离 | 独立命名空间（`expert_council` / `/experts` / `dsh-expert-council` / `expert-council`）；不 import Agent Teams 服务、不调用 `spawn_teammate` / `te

readme.section: 谁能用、什么时候用（显式调用）
readme.text:
- 你明确发起才算数：`/experts <团队> <问题>`、面板「召开会诊」、或对话里点名「用专家团…」。
- 模型不能自作主张：默认提示词是**被动**的；工具 `convene` 不带 `explicit_request` + `request_quote` 会被拒绝，错误信息会要求它改由你发起。
- 每次会诊的 `consent` 都记进台账（`user-action` / `explicit-request` + 原话），事后可查是谁发起的。
- 读动作（`teams/experts/get/list`）不受门禁影响；它们只用于回答你的点名请求。

1. **斜杠命令**（会话里最轻）：
   - `/experts` — 看团队清单与玩法
   - `/experts experts` — 看全部专家镜头定义
   - `/experts architecture` — 看团队议程/成员/预算
   - `/experts architecture 要不要把导出拆成独立进程？` — 直接立案，拿到会诊简报（由你发起）
2. **面板**：侧边栏「专家团」→ 选团队 → 填问题（可选背景/档位/预算上限）→「召开会诊」→ 新会话带着简报开始，模型按协议逐轮写回。
3. **模型工具**：会话里点名「叫专家团评审一下 X」后，模型调用
   `expert_council({action:'convene', team_id, question, explicit_request:true, request_quote:'<你的原话>'})` → `record` → `verdict`。
   不点名就不会发生：模型主动调用会被工具层拒绝。

- 面板里可以：新建/编辑专家（职责、镜头、必问、红线、**盲区**、互补、预算）、新建/编辑团队（成员、恰好一个主持、议程、产出物、三档预算）、隐藏内置模板、重置回出厂。
- 数据落在 `$DSH_HOME/expert-council/customization.json`；内置名册仍由代码提供，改内置=写入同 id 的覆盖层（标记 `custom:true`，`preset:true`），不会修改代码。
- 模型侧也可写：`expert_council({action:'save_expert', expert:{...}, request_quote:'<你的原话>'})`、`save_team`、`delete`、`reset({confirm:true})`；校验在 service 层（id、必填、成员存在、单主持、预算单调）。
- 删除专家会自动从自定义团队里摘除并报告受影响团队；团队没人时会标记 `incomplete` 且拒绝召开。
- 每次改动都会写入 `history`（谁、什么动作、你的原话、影响），面板「最近调整」可查。

readme.section: 用一句话调整（不用懂配置）
readme.text:
不会字段/预算/主持人这些概念也没关系：直接用自然语言描述你要什么。

1. **面板**：列表页「用一句话调整」→ 填一句话（或点示例 chip）→「交给专家团助手」→ 新会话带着字段级简报开工，模型用工具把改动落到目录里，面板 3 秒内自动刷新；「最近调整」会记录改了什么、依据你哪句话。
2. **命令**：`/experts 调整 加一个只看数据授权的合规专家，并放进安全评审团` —— 直接返回同一份简报，交给模型执行即可。
3. **模型工具**：`expert_council({action:'customize', request:'<你的原话>'})` 拿到简报，再用 `save_expert` / `save_team` / `delete`（均带 `request_quote`）落库。

安全边界：模型侧任何目录写入同样需要 `request_quote`（你的原话）；破坏性操作（删除/重置/覆盖内置）在简报规则里要求先说明影响；所有改动可一键重置回出厂。

| id | 名称 | 成员 | 默认档 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `architecture` | 架构评审团 | architect / security / sre / performance / cost | standard |
| `security-review` | 安全评审团 | security / skeptic / sre / legal | standard |
| `product-decision` | 产品决策团 | product / ux / data / cost / skeptic | standard |
| `code-review` | 代码评审团 | architect / security / performance / skeptic | lean |
| `research-review` | 研究评议团 | domain / researcher / data / skeptic | standard |
| `incident-retro` | 事故复盘团 | sre / security / operator / data | standard |
| `shipping` | 上线评审团 | operator / sre / security / product | lean |
| `debate` | 红蓝对抗团 | skeptic / domain / architect / integrator | deep |

结构：`architect` 架构师、`performance` 性能工程师、`data` 数据科学家、`researcher` 研究者；
风险：`security` 安全专家、`sre` 可靠性工程师、`legal` 合规与法务、`skeptic` 质疑者（红队）；
用户：`product` 产品负责人、`ux` 用户研究员、`domain` 领域专家；
执行：`cost` 成本与运营、`integrator` 综合者（主持）、`operator` 落地与运维。

每个镜头的完整定义在 `lib/experts.js`；团队在 `lib/teams.js`；两者都是数据，加人/加团队不改流程代码。

- **只加载选中的镜头**：brief 只渲染本团专家卡，不加载 14 个镜头全集。
- **三档**：`lean`（单轮多镜头，约 34% 预算）、`standard`（独立意见 + 一轮交叉质询）、`deep`（并行独立 + 匿名互评，约 2.6×）。
- **可调**：`budget_cap` 覆盖总量（200–20000 token）；brief 给出每人额度与裁决预留。
- **记账**：每次 `record` 返回实际 token、`overBudget`；`verdict` 汇总总量并告警。
- 默认建议：日常评审用 lean；只有不可逆/高成本决策才升 standard/deep。

readme.section: 设计来源（集百家之长，代码原创）
readme.text:
- 独立先写、匿名互评：Karpathy 式 LLM Council（[council-review](https://github.com/ngmeyer/council-review)）的思想；
- 角色/职责拆分：BMAD-METHOD（[bmad-method](https://www.npmjs.com/package/bmad-method)）的 agent persona 思路；
- 证据门槛、异议档案、推翻条件：工程评审与审计实践。

均未复制代码；本插件为独立实现（MIT）。

- 自动化：`node --test "test/*.test.mjs"` → **37/37**（core 6 + service 6 + api 3 + custom 6 + customize 6 + client 10）；`smith verify` L0 20 文件语法 + L1 全过。
- 活体（已装入 desktop profile，真实模型 + 真实工具）：
  - **自然语言调整**：面板 `nl-request` 返回 2,139 字符字段级简报（原话 + 目录 + 四种动作 + 规则 + 示例），不改目录；工具 `customize` 返回同一份；隔离实例点示例 chip → 填入 → 立案 → 新会话带简报（截图 `docs/assets/`）。
  - **写入门禁**：模型 `save_expert` 不带 `request_quote` 被拒（原文：「调整专家团也需要你的原话…」）；带原话成功并写 `history{actor:'agent', action:'expert-create', request:…}`；`delete` 同样留痕（`expert-delete`）。
  - **显式调用**（V0.2 已验，仍有效）：模型无原话 `convene` 被拒；带 `explicit_request:true` + `request_quote` 放行并落 `consent`。
  - **自定义**（V0.2 已验）：保存专家/团队、覆盖内置、隐藏、`reset-custom` 回 14/8 默认，`history` 记录重置。
  - **隔离**：`checkIsolation()` 零碰撞；面板/brief/提示词均写明与内置 Agent Teams 无关。
- 浏览器验收（隔离实例，仓库内截图 `docs/assets/`）：团队/专家编辑器、被动同意条、一句话调整区、最近调整（9 种动作标签、原话、actor、时间）、375 同序堆叠。
- 过程中发现并修复的机制问题：工具缺 `output` 契约会被 dsh-tools 静默拒绝；分歧检测跨轮累积；删除自定义专家会误加 hidden 列表（均已补测试）。

readme.section: 与 DSH 智能体团队的边界
readme.text:
- 本插件**不是** Agent Teams：不注册/不调用 `spawn_teammate`、`team_task_*`、`send_message` 等内置工具，不创建、不调度、不结束任何子代理。
- 这里的「团队」只是镜头集合 + 会诊协议，每次会诊由当前会话的主模型按镜头逐条写成，不产生并行代理。
- 命名空间独立：工具 `expert_council`、命令 `/experts`、面板 id `dsh-expert-council`、数据目录 `expert-council`、会诊 id 前缀 `ec-`；`lib/isolation.js` 集中声明并用测试断言不与内置 Agent Teams 名字冲突。
- 若将来内置 Agent Teams 也提供「专家团」类面板，两者数据、入口、台账完全独立，不会互相覆盖。

- 不做「自动投票取胜」：裁决由主持给出并必须回应异议，分歧不会被平均掉。
- 不替代真实专家：`deep` 模式下的并行子代理仍由调用方决定（本插件负责协议、预算与落账）。
- 不碰网络、不执行第三方代码；审计/令牌只做本地统计。

- `0.3.0`：自然语言调整（面板「用一句话调整」/ `/experts 调整` / `customize` 简报 + 变更历史），界面分区捋顺。
- `0.2.0`：显式调用门禁（consent 落库）、专家/团队自定义（面板 + 工具，覆盖内置、隐藏、重置）、与内置 Agent Teams 的隔离边界。
- `0.1.0`：首次发布（14 镜头、8 团队、7 铁律、三档预算、三入口、决策台账）。

> One sentence, a panel of experts, and a decision you can audit. Not "several chatbots": a protocol — independent opinions, evidence gates, cross-examination only on disagreement, recorded dissent, reversal triggers.

A plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/YansongG-HKU). The Host owns the expert roster, the user's customisation layer, the collaboration protocol, token budgets and the consult ledger; the Client renders the sidebar panel; the model gets one tool (`expert_council`), the human gets one command (`/experts`). All three write the same ledger.

**Three hard rules**

1. **User-gated only**: the model cannot convene a panel by itself. `/experts` and the panel are user actions; a model-initiated convene must carry `explicit_request:true` + `request_quote` (your own words) and is recorded as consent.
2. **Editable**: experts and team compositions can be changed any time — including in plain language, without knowing the fields.
3. **Isolated**: not the built-in DSH Agent Teams. It never spawns teammates, never calls `spawn_teammate` / `team_task_*`, and its "teams" are expert lenses plus a protocol.

readme.section: Why it is not just pretty UI
readme.text:
| Mechanism | How it is enforced |
| --- | --- |
| Expert definition | 14 lenses, each with `mandate / lens / asks / redLines / misses / budget`; `misses` records the lens's known bias, the panel shows it as "other lenses will cover this" |
| Independent first | Standard/deep panels write each lens separately; deep panels use anonymous peer review |
| Evidence gate | Every claim needs evidence; unevidenced claims are downgraded to assumptions and lower the verdict's coverage score |
| Disagreement only | `record` detects stance conflicts and confidence gaps (≥0.45); a verdict that ignores a proven disagreement is rejected unless `force` is set |
| Dissent on record | Verdicts must carry `dissent / unresolved / reversalTriggers / actions`; dissent cannot be empty when a disagreement was proven |
| Budget hard cap | Three depths with per-expert budgets, whole-consult caps, over-budget warnings, and only the selected lenses are loaded |
| Decision ledger | Consults are persisted (`consults.json`) with rounds, opinions, disagreements, verdict, tokens; a verdict can never be overwritten |
| Three entry points, one service | Tool, command and panel call the same `service` — one gate impl

- `/experts` — list teams and how to use them
- `/experts experts` — list all expert lenses
- `/experts architecture` — inspect a team (members, agenda, budgets)
- `/experts architecture should we split export into a service?` — open a consult, get the brief
- `/experts 调整 add a privacy expert and put them in the security panel` — plain-language customisation brief

Sidebar 「专家团」 → pick a team → fill the question (optional context / depth / budget cap) → convene: a new session starts with the brief. Or use 「用一句话调整」 to describe a change and let the assistant apply it.

You do not need to know the config. Say what you want; the plugin turns it into a field-level brief (your words + current catalogue + allowed actions + field reference + rules + examples) and the model applies it through guarded writes:

- Panel: 「用一句话调整」 → 「交给专家团助手」
- Command: `/experts 调整 <one sentence>`
- Tool: `expert_council({action:'customize', request:'<your sentence>'})`
Model-side catalogue writes require `request_quote`; every change is recorded in `customization.json` history and shown under 「最近调整」; reset restores the shipped catalogue.

8 presets: architecture review, security review, product decision, code review, research review, incident retro, shipping review, red/blue debate.
14 lenses: architect, security, SRE, performance, data, product, UX research, cost & ops, legal & compliance, domain expert, skeptic / red team, integrator (chair), researcher, operator.

Presets are data in `lib/experts.js` / `lib/teams.js`; user changes live in an override layer.

- Only the chosen team's lenses are rendered into the brief.
- Three depths: `lean` (single pass, ~34% of the standard budget), `standard` (independent opinions + one cross-examination round), `deep` (parallel independent + anonymous peer review, ~2.6×).
- `budget_cap` overrides the whole-consult cap (200–20000); every `record` reports real tokens and `overBudget`; `verdict` summarises and warns.
- Default advice: lean for routine reviews, standard for real decisions, deep only for irreversible/high-cost ones.
```bash

readme.section: install into your DSH profile and enable the bundle
readme.text:
pnpm --dir <profile> add link:/path/to/dsh-expert-council
```

Then add `dsh-expert-council` to `dsh.profile.bundles` in the profile `package.json` (or let the plugin manager do it). After a reload: the sidebar panel appears, `/experts` works, and the `expert_council` tool is registered for new sessions.

```bash
node --check index.js client.js
node --test "test/*.test.mjs"
```

37 tests cover protocol gates, budgets, consent, customisation, isolation, the tool, the command, the panel route and the client registration.

- It does not do "majority vote wins": the chair decides and must answer every dissent.
- It is not an agent orchestrator; `deep` panels never spawn subagents silently.
- No network access, no third-party code execution; all state is local files under `$DSH_HOME/expert-council/`.

Independent-first review and anonymous peer review follow the LLM-council idea ([council-review](https://github.com/ngmeyer/council-review)); role/mandate separation follows BMAD-METHOD's agent-persona approach; evidence gates, dissent records and reversal triggers come from engineering review and audit practice. No code was copied; this is an independent MIT implementation.
